purpose: Localize the remaining characteristic_transport_v1 instability: straight outlet without corners versus rectangular faces/corners. Do not promote a solver from short-test success.
baseline: Installed research wheel0.5.2, SHA256 a3c2930ffcf45cf326fd09217c1afb9bea69c91299a8d83eafbe31c56e49639f; production main0.5.1 remains unchanged

case.collision: unchanged compressible zero-centered D3Q27 cumulant, default bulk rate1, no SGS
case.initial_noise: Independent deterministic normal rho and all3 velocity perturbations, std1e-8, each owned-component spatial mean removed; initialize equilibrium PDFs; ghost PDFs initialized deterministically

gates.early_stop: energy ratio>10000 or max|rho-1|>.05 or localMa>.3; keep the failed result, never relax its gate

interpretation: The boundedness gate is the earlier glancing1.1 criterion, not experimental validation. Strong-growth detection is a diagnostic flag distinct from that gate. Any rectangular-only failure does not prove a corner defect by itself; follow with controlled corner-only changes. Any straight-outlet failure requires analysis of its full coupled operator.
invariants: Do not retune Reynolds number, viscosity, collision rates, lattice speed or existing acoustic/vortex acceptance gates
No change to main or new Windows distribution before long airfoil gates pass
No export of new binary fields/images/wheels after prior approval rejection; publish source, already prepared text results and hashes only if publishing
next_if_corner_supported: Derive a consistent Cartesian-face treatment of corner ghost populations, test it separately on the same noise fixtures and the unchanged earlier verification gates before any profile claim
